title: Fix same-day overdue recurring task rescheduling
description: td-reschedule-overdue used task update --due with each recurring task's existing rule, assuming Todoist would idempotently re-evaluate it. Live testing showed this operation advances recurrence state and causes overdue daily tasks to skip today's occurrence regardless of whether today's scheduled time has passed. Diagnose the exact API semantics, use a safe same-day policy for daily tasks without changing non-daily behavior, add regression coverage, validate live against Todoist's Tester project, and document the flaw and operational behavior in the Todoist engineering notes.
acceptance_criteria: Daily recurring tasks overdue from a prior day reschedule to today when today is a valid occurrence, regardless of whether today's scheduled time has passed; non-daily recurrences still advance to the next rule occurrence; automated regression tests cover the Aug 2 case; live Tester-project verification preserves recurrence, time of day, and reminders; todoist.md and repository work logs are updated.
notes: Live Tester-project findings on 2026-08-02: task add with 'every day at 4pm' at 14:03 Pacific correctly chose today 16:00, falsifying UTC and time-passed explanations. Re-sending an existing recurring due.string via task update is occurrence advancement, not idempotent rule re-evaluation: a current Aug 2 16:00 task moved to Aug 3 on the first call and Aug 4 on the second; an overdue Aug 1 task moved directly to Aug 3; equivalent text and one-off-to-recurring updates also landed Aug 3. Full-datetime task reschedule moved an overdue daily task to the already-passed 09:00 occurrence today while preserving isRecurring, the exact rule, and a relative reminder; completing that occurrence advanced to tomorrow with recurrence and reminder intact. Production CLI e2e: daily 09:00 and 16:00 moved Aug 1 to Aug 2, weekly Saturday 16:00 moved Aug 1 to Aug 8, all reminders/rules/times verified. Five focused and 28 total bin tests passed. All tdtest fixtures were safety-checked and deleted; Tester returned to zero tasks.
close_reason: Fixed daily catch-up semantics, added regression coverage, verified production CLI live in Tester, and updated Todoist plus repository documentation.
